note: Every function directory (scripts/generate-tenant-isolation-cases.ts readFunctions) is moved, exempt (it has no caller to take a tenant from, and says why) or pending. A pending function names the board sub-task of PPY-7dc463 that moves it, and the list only shrinks: a function leaves it in the PR that moves it.

exempt.tenant-claims: The Cognito pre-token-generation trigger (PPY-0bb0fd) is what mints the caller's tenant claims at sign-in: it has no caller whose claims it could take a tenant from, and reads the membership rows of the user signing in.
exempt.localization-dispatch: A DynamoDB stream consumer of the LocalizationRequest table that a dedicated stack alone deploys (amplify/site-backend.ts wires it only when tenancy is not shared): its records carry no caller, and a shared stack has no dispatcher to name a tenant for.
exempt.entity-label-sync: A DynamoDB stream consumer of the SemanticNode table that a dedicated stack alone deploys (amplify/site-backend.ts wires it only when tenancy is not shared): its records carry no caller, and a shared stack has no writer to name a tenant for.
exempt.item-change-feed: A DynamoDB stream consumer of the Item table that a dedicated stack alone deploys, and only when the site names its tenant (amplify/site-backend.ts wires it only when tenancy is not shared): its records carry no caller, it acts for the one tenant its stack names (PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID), and it skips a row of any other tenant before reading or sending anything.
